_comment: Watchdog member list. One entry per member the watchdog should keep alive. 'start' is the command used when that member is not listening (first item = executable, rest = arguments). Add a new member by adding one entry here - no script edit needed. NOTE: each member must have exactly ONE owner here - two entries for the same id fight each other, and the board then shows a member that is 'online' but answers nothing.

members.why: Codex 通道（app-server）必须经 cmd 启动：自启动链直接 spawn codex.exe 会 ENOENT
引擎是 codex-cli：被点名时真的产出回复并写回黑板（不再是只挂心跳的监听器）
WorkBuddy 自身只做长轮询 + 人工唤起，接在黑板上会静默；这里用 codex-cli 引擎代它产出回复
